cohort: Women aged 18 to 45 with low-risk, term pregnancies who delivered between June 2008 and April 2012 at a University Hospital in Bogota, Colombia.
finding: CDMR was associated with a lower rate of adverse perinatal outcomes compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery in low-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: Among low-risk pregnancy women, CDMR was associated with a lower rate of adverse perinatal outcomes when compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery.
